import sys, json, time, resource, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from formats import read_request
from pipeline import execute
motifs=[]
for i in range(1024):
    motifs.append([1515 + 20*((i >> (j % 10)) & 1) for j in range(16)])
disc=[]
for m in motifs:
    for _ in range(2):
        vals=[0]*24+list(m)+[0]*24
        disc.append({'class':0,'values':vals,'activation':[0]*24+[100]*16+[0]*24})
validation=[]
for r in range(128):
    body=[]
    for k in range(8):
        body += motifs[(r*8+k) % 1024]
    validation.append({'class':0,'values':body[:128]})
rel={'id':'m','classes':1,'width':16,'eps':[1,1],'ratio':[1,1024],'threshold':[0,1],
     'mode':'range','packet_limit':200000,'idle_us':10**12,'discovery':disc,
     'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1515]*16}],'validation':validation}
blocks=[[['install','m']]]
nflow=8192; per=24; extra=3392
ops=1
for f in range(nflow):
    fid='f%d'%f
    block=[['open',fid]]; ops+=1
    ts=0
    for p in range(per + (1 if f<extra else 0)):
        block.append(['packet',fid,ts,0,300+p%50]); ts+=1; ops+=1
    block.append(['close',fid]); ops+=1
    blocks.append(block)
while ops<218432:
    blocks[-1].append(['install','m']); ops+=1
req={'capacity':{'range':4096,'exact':4096},'releases':[rel],'blocks':blocks}
data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('bytes',len(data))
start=time.time()
out=execute(read_request(io.BytesIO(data)))
cat=out['catalog'][0]
print('clusters',len(cat['clusters']),'kept',len(cat['priority']),'fragments',len(cat['fragments']))
print('%.2fs rss=%dMB' % (time.time()-start, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss//1024))
print('reasons', {r:sum(1 for d in out['decisions'] if d['reason']==r) for r in ('segment','idle','limit','close')})
PYEOF
